02 / THE THREAD THROUGH IT ALL✳

Hey, I’m Tom.
I like figuring
things out.

I’m a computer science student at SUNY Poly, a photographer, and an outdoors person from Upstate New York. My path started with computer application programming at MVCC, and the curiosity kept going.

Some days that means building a better tool. Other days it’s chasing a wildlife shot, getting out on Delta Lake, or packing for the Adirondacks. I like projects that give me something new to learn.

02 / CAPTURE

Work the problem.

A longer lens, a steadier frame, a faster shutter. Wildlife photography keeps giving me new things to learn.

03 / SHAPE

Make the edit.

Sort the keepers in Lightroom, shape the color, and reach for Photoshop when the image needs more work.

THE FOUNDATION

Learn a thing.
Build a thing.
Repeat.

My path started in computer application programming at MVCC and continues in computer science at SUNY Poly. I work across Python, C++, Java, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, and C#. The best projects connect something I’m learning with something I care about.

03 / IT ALL CONNECTS

A trip becomes a film.
A place becomes a project.
An idea becomes the next adventure.

Fishing for bass and pickerel. Working on the MirroCraft. Getting out with a camera. Packing a small camp into a backpack. These aren’t separate lives. They keep feeding into each other.

That’s the thread through Focused on Tom: making things, understanding them, and giving myself more reasons to explore.
